rule: An advisory on this list has been assessed by a person and found unreachable here. scripts/audit-register.mjs lets exactly these through and fails on any other high or critical production advisory, so a new one is the only thing anyone sees. Each entry says why in CHECKABLE terms (mustStayAbsent): if any pattern starts matching, the entry stops being true and the check fails until it is re-assessed. An entry also expires on reviewBy. Entries are never a way to hide a red: do not add one without a decision file. See docs/decisions/2026-10-28-advisory-register.md.

accepted.title: glob CLI: Command injection via -c/--cmd executes matches with shell:true
accepted.why: The flaw is in glob's command-line binary, not its library API. Nothing in this repo runs that binary, and glob arrives only through the build-time chain @opennextjs/cloudflare > @opennextjs/aws > @node-minify/core.

mustStayAbsent.what: any invocation of the glob binary or @node-minify from package.json, scripts/ or worker/

mustBeAbsentFromBuild.what: the built Worker bundle (checked only when a build is present; reported as not checked otherwise)

resolved.note: Cleared by the adapter upgrade on 2026-10-28. Deliberately NOT accepted: if one comes back it is a regression and should be seen.
